up: Identify compounds selective for target CHEMBL2971 (JAK2) over target CHEMBL2835 (JAK1) with IC50 < 50 nM against JAK2 and IC50 > 200 nM against JAK1. Filter activities to standard_relation = '=' and standard_units = 'nM'. Return exactly two columns: compound_chembl_id (sourced from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id) and canonical_smiles. Use set semantics to return each qualifying compound exactly once, avoiding multiplicative joins over raw activity rows.
sql: WITH jak2_hits AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.molregno FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2971' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_value < 50), jak1_hits AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.molregno FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2835' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_value > 200) SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM jak2_hits j2 JOIN jak1_hits j1 ON j2.molregno = j1.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON j2.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
